directionAndCraft: Preserves the incumbent AppKit system and conversation hierarchy. You messages have role, symbol, tint and alignment distinction. Checkpoint history and protected restore communicate scope, safety copy and new conversation. Run stays supporting context and distinguishes Stop App from agent execution. No visual rebuild needed.

findings.title: Message checkpoint links can select a different checkpoint
findings.resolution: Worker resolves the selected ID to its history page and rejects missing IDs. Native selection no longer falls back to another entry; the existing panel retargets, and newer link intent is retained during loading. Targeted native tests, desktop protocol coverage, and before/after native diagnostics support the correction. No attributable material regression found in the scoped follow-up.
findings.evidence: A new panel always requests offset zero and falls back to row zero when the requested selectedID is outside the latest 100 entries. An already-visible panel is merely focused and ignores the newly requested ID. Both routes can leave a different version selected after the user clicks a message checkpoint link.
findings.correction: Resolve and select the requested ID even across history pages and in an existing panel. If unavailable, report that explicitly and keep restore disabled instead of silently selecting another checkpoint. Verify both a link older than 100 entries and a second link while the history panel is open.
